items.title: Anand Rathi Wealth among 4 F&O stocks seeing a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of October 1, four stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a rise of more than 13% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session, according to StockEdge F&O scan data. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This may reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of their existing positions.

items.title: Yes Bank shares rise 3% after Q2 business update shows loans surging 24% YoY, deposits up 20%
items.description: Yes Bank shares rose after the lender reported a 23.8% YoY growth in loans and advances to around Rs 3.1 lakh crore in Q2 FY27. Deposits also grew nearly 20% YoY, signalling continued business momentum.

items.title: Top Nifty50 stocks analysts suggest buying in this volatile week
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, is a comprehensive report that evaluates five key components of 4,000+ listed stocks – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum – to generate standardised scores. The simple average of the above-mentioned five component ratings is normally distributed to reach an average score.

items.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex rallies 700 points, Nifty above 22,600. 6 key factors driving rebound
items.description: After a long slump, the Indian stock market is experiencing a refreshing surge, with both Sensex and Nifty indices showcasing notable increases. The recent leadership transition at HDFC Bank has invigorated investor trust and market dynamics. With oil prices dropping and inflation worries easing, combined with a calming outlook on Federal Reserve rate hikes, investors appear to be regaining their footing and confidence.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares rise 2% after appointing Anup Bagchi as new CEO, Q2 biz update. Buy, sell or hold?
items.description: HDFC Bank shares rose after Anup Bagchi was appointed as the bank’s new MD & CEO, ending months of uncertainty over its top leadership. Brokerages Jefferies, Morgan Stanley and Citi retained positive ratings on the stock, citing clarity on succession and potential for a re-rating. The bank also reported strong loan and deposit growth in Q2.

items.title: Siemens Energy among 5 stocks showing RSI Trending Up
items.description: On October 1, five stocks from the Nifty500 pack featured in StockEdge’s “RSI Trending Up” scan. The scan identifies stocks where the RSI value has crossed above 50 from below, signalling strengthening momentum.“RSI trending up” means the Relative Strength Index (RSI) is rising, indicating improving price momentum. RSI is a technical indicator commonly used by traders to assess momentum and trend strength.

items.title: Runwal Enterprises shares to list today; check GMP and key details ahead of debut
items.description: Runwal Enterprises shares are set to list on the BSE and NSE with a zero GMP, indicating expectations of a flat debut near the IPO price of Rs 305. The Rs 500-crore IPO, entirely a fresh issue, was subscribed 2.64 times, led by QIB and NII demand at 4.10 times and 4.14 times, respectively, while the retail portion was subscribed 1.19 times.

items.title: German Green Steel shares to list today. Check GMP ahead of debut
items.description: German Green Steel & Power is set to debut on the BSE and NSE after its Rs 303.90 crore IPO was subscribed 30.42 times. With a 7% GMP, shares may list around Rs 149, while strong FY26 revenue and profit growth support investor interest.

items.title: CCL Products among 3 stocks that closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On October 1, the closing prices of three stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 2% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. When the closing price is above the VWAP, it implies that the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Augmont Enterprises among 3 stocks showing White Marubozu Pattern
items.description: On October 1, three stocks with market cap over Rs 10,000 crore appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest. The pattern is represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow. It reflects strong upward price movement during the session, with the price moving from the opening level toward the session high by the close. The pattern is commonly studied in technical analysis as an indicator of price momentum.

items.title: TCS, Infosys and other IT stocks in focus after Accenture Q4 revenue, outlook beat estimates
items.description: Indian IT stocks including TCS and Infosys are in focus following Accenture's strong Q4 results and above-estimate revenue guidance. While the outlook signals potential recovery in discretionary technology spending, analysts warn that Indian IT firms may still report their weakest Q2 growth in three years amid AI-led pricing pressures.

items.title: Orient Cables shares make electrifying debut, list at 65% premium over IPO price
items.description: The Rs 552-crore Orient Cables IPO was a book-built issue comprising a fresh issue of 1.18 crore shares worth Rs 320 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 85.29 lakh shares worth Rs 232 crore.

items.title: AceVector shares list at 12% discount to IPO price on BSE, NSE
items.description: The Rs 420-crore public issue was priced in the range of Rs 30–32 per share, with the upper end of the price band at Rs 32. The issue comprised a fresh issue of 8.97 crore shares aggregating to Rs 287 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 4.16 crore shares worth Rs 133 crore.

items.title: Markets bet on RBI rate hike as inflation pressure builds
items.description: As inflation concerns rise, investors are putting their faith in the Reserve Bank of India to implement an interest rate hike. A survey reveals that nearly 60% of economists believe a 25-basis-point increase is likely at the coming policy meeting. With an eye on foreign investment, expectations are growing for a tightening cycle to kick off in October, setting the stage for how future capital flows will be managed.

items.title: Nifty rebound in sight after record 8-week losing streak: Analysts
items.description: Nifty has dipped significantly, nearing a critical support range of 22,000 to 22,600, catching the attention of traders looking for a potential technical rebound in the oversold market. Analysts recommend buying Indian Hotel and Mankind Pharma stocks, highlighting ambitious targets and stop-loss settings. Conversely, caution is warranted for IOC and Torrent Pharma, which display signs of decline. The market strategy appears optimistic for October, tapping into seasonal recovery prospects.

items.title: Negative Breakout: These 7 stocks cross below their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty200 pack, 7 stocks' closing prices crossed below their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 1, according to technical scan data from StockEdge. Trading below the 200 DMA is generally considered a negative signal, as it suggests that a stock’s price is below its long-term trend. The 200 DMA is a widely used technical indicator that helps traders assess the overall trend of a stock.
